scope: Make crafted droid detonation use Publish 14.1 module-rating damage, a fixed blast radius, and fixed PvP reduction while removing the victim's NGE combat level from live damage authority.

findings: Publish 14.1 computes each detonation from the crafted module rating using a 150 through 200 damage roll per rating point.
The Publish 14.1 blast searches a fixed 17 meter radius and applies a fixed 25 percent PvP damage multiplier to player defenders.
Publish 14.1 admission requires the owner to hold Novice Smuggler or Novice Bounty Hunter; the defender's combat level never participates in damage.
